Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenue, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - All Governmental Funds, Total Governmental Funds column (pp8, 10); business-type from the proprietary funds Statement of Revenue, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position, Total Enterprise Funds column (p14; Internal Service Funds excluded). Business-type other financing = aid in construction 27,990 + gain on sale of assets 70,240; transfers net 32,617 - 30,000. Proceeds from sale of bonds 1,520,000 (Debt Service Fund, other financing sources) -> debt_proceeds. Capital outlay has no function printed except the Street Fund column. ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet 'Cash - unrestricted' Total 5,962,734 (p6); restricted cash 2,331,172 and cash with county treasurer 130,154 not included; beginning cash not printed. governmental_net_position: beginning as originally stated 45,008,835, prior period adjustment (68,904) (Note 23), restated 44,939,931 (p4). Government-wide business-type net position 29,575,903 differs from the enterprise funds' 29,597,155 (internal service fund allocation). The only supplementary schedule (p19 Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis - All Funds) combines governmental and business-type funds on a cash basis, so detail is per fund column of the governmental funds statement and the proprietary funds statement (as FY2023); the budget schedule is not recorded.
